Close up produk bila explain tentang function produk.' Caption = the 6 Nov Rubik Mono One word style (the screenshot shows the same style), size/position matched to the screenshot (cap height ~52 px, centred at ~74 % = 1423 px, ~230 px above the yellow-bag label). Segments keep ~0.2 s before and ~0.3 s after the speech and pauses inside a line shrink to 0.5 s (tighten keep 0.25). The clip is a wide living-room shot, so the A-roll is zoomed toward the owner and the frame; close-ups of the frame (same take) whenever he explains a feature. Tilam (owner, 11 Nov): 'untuk Tilam pun sama, overlay yang perlu sahaja. Gunakan juga klip yang lama untuk overlay contoh tilam bergulung dan tengok lah mana yang perlu lagi.' Voiceover over the owner's footage; close-ups of the mattress (quilting, mesh side, hand press) whenever a feature is named.
